title: A2A-T negotiation test corpus format
description: First-hand definition of the data-driven negotiation test corpus consumed by the negotiation testdata harness (NegotiationCaseLoader and the later CaseEngine suites). Every corpus file is a JSON array of records: case files carry case records, scenario files carry scenario records, live files carry live-LLM case records, and the two shared files carry reusable LLM payloads and JSON Schema variants. The loader parses everything in strict mode, so an unknown key is an error, never a silently ignored typo.

language.title: Language tag of the bundled negotiation resources

api.title: API under test
api.description: Exactly the twelve methods of the negotiation content service plus the three closed-loop task APIs (the A2ATClient task generation methods and the A2ATServer task validation method, reached through the mirrored prompt-module production wiring); the CaseEngine dispatches on this value.

priority.title: Test priority
priority.description: P0 contract, P1 boundary and retry behavior, P2 rare probes.

inject.title: Harness injection hook
inject.description: Maps a corpus case onto a real builder injection point; failingTemplateLoader triggers template.not_found on the generation family, failingSemanticValidator replays the missing semantic validation prompt resources of the validate family (mapped onto template.not_found by the validation pipeline).

templateUri.title: Content template URI
templateUri.description: Intentionally permissive: programming-error cases carry deliberately malformed URIs (wrong version segment, wrong extension name, misspelled type, unknown phase). Task-family records address the Task-T templates, such as Task-T/network-layer/private-line-complaint/v1.

context.title: Negotiation context
context.description: Inline on every case and every scenario step; scenario steps restate it per step so the round evolution stays visible. A JSON null expresses the null-context probes of the validate family.

input.title: API input
input.description: text maps each language to its free-text input; data carries the language-independent typed content of the from-data family. Happy-path from-text cases may carry both for the differential double run.

failMarker.title: Scripted LLM failure marker
failMarker.description: runtime-exception throws an infrastructure error, llm-error answers an LLM error response, null-response returns null, blank-content returns a blank payload, non-json returns an unparseable payload, assertion is the zero-call proof of the from-data and differential runs.

oneOf.title: Shared response reference
oneOf.description: Resolves to the named payload in shared/llm-responses.json; the scope is locked to the responses/ prefix.

oneOf.title: Inline payload
oneOf.description: A literal JSON string carrying the payload text verbatim.

llm.title: Scripted LLM behavior
llm.description: maxAttempts is a builder-level value (clamping belongs to the handwritten suites). The script is consumed step by step; exhausting it fails the run instead of repeating the last answer.

prompt.title: Prompt input of the validate family
prompt.description: Exactly one of the three: a golden fixture name resolved per language, an inline prompt text, or the step whose generated prompt text feeds this validation step.

schemaReference.title: Shared schema reference
schemaReference.description: Resolves to the named JSON Schema variant in shared/schemas.json; the scope is locked to the schemas/ prefix. An inline schema object is also accepted.

params.description: Expected merged FilledParamData map; always contains the context keys id, round and maxRounds. When missingParams is present the entries are a subset check with exact values instead of full-map equality, and JSON null values are rejected — a missing parameter belongs into missingParams.

differential.description: Marks the from-text plus from-data double run asserting that both outputs equal each other and the golden fixture.

promptTextContains.description: Task family: structural fragments the generated task prompt text must contain, such as the ## 任务类型(Task Type) style section headers.

missingParams.description: Task validation: the exact set of schema parameter names expected to be missing — the null-valued entries of the filled parameter data, the causal starting point of the information negotiation. An empty array asserts that nothing is missing.

paramsFromStep.description: Scenario steps only: the number of the earlier task-validation step whose missing parameters this validation step must have filled with values (the 缺参 -> 补参 causal link); resolved by the ScenarioEngine.

expectFailure.title: Failure expectation
expectFailure.description: Discriminated union with the success block: the failure block must name the expected exception type or the expected error code.

missingParamsFilled.description: The number of the task-validation step whose missing parameters must be filled with values by the later steps of the flow — the 缺参 -> 补参 causal chain asserted at flow level.

case.title: Corpus case record
case.description: One fully self-describing test case; key order is fixed (id, api, languages, priority, tags, summary, context, templateUri, input, llm, expect) so diffs stay localized.

id.title: Globally unique case id
id.description: Naming syntax: <family>-<category>-<number> such as FT-RETRY-02. The loader expands it per language into id/zh-CN and id/en-US.

scenarioStep.title: Scenario step record
scenarioStep.description: A case record plus the three step-level extension keys: the consecutive step number, the acting role and the cross-step prompt reference carried inside prompt.fromStep.

scenario.title: Scenario record
scenario.description: A multi-step multi-API interaction over the content layer; every step is a full case record and the scenario adds the step list, the roles and the flow-level expectation.

rolesDesc.title: Role semantics of the closed loop
rolesDesc.description: Business meaning of each role, keyed by role name, such as {"A": "工作台（client，任务发起/补数方）", "B": "OMC（server，执行/要数方，协商发起方）"}. Every key must name a declared role; the descriptions travel into the engine failure messages and the run summary.

liveExpectation.title: Live expectation block
liveExpectation.description: The looser expectation of the live family: subset parameter assertions and an LLM call upper bound instead of the offline exact equivalence; no golden fixture and no differential. Live phase 1 expects the success path only, so success false carries no failure details.

success.description: Expected operation outcome: true expects the operation to succeed, false expects it to fail.

scenarioCode.description: Expected recognized scenario code, judged as the scenario segment of the echoed template URI.

paramsContains.description: Subset check: the named slots must be filled with exactly these values (other slots are not asserted). JSON null values are rejected — a missing parameter belongs into paramsAbsent.

paramsAbsent.description: Slots that must be null or missing.

promptTextContains.description: Generate API only: structural fragments the generated task prompt text must contain; the loader rejects the key on validate records.

maxLlmCalls.description: Upper bound of LLM calls the case may trigger (a real model may trigger pipeline-internal retries); the loader defaults it to 4 when omitted.

liveCase.title: Live-LLM case record
liveCase.description: One live family record under live/: no llm script, no inject hook and no typed input data — the behavior under test comes from the real model — with the looser live expectation block instead of the offline one. Ids carry the LIVE- prefix; phase 1 covers zh-CN and the two task APIs only.

id.title: Live case id
id.description: Naming syntax with the mandatory LIVE- prefix, such as LIVE-GEN-01; expanded per language like the offline ids.

input.title: Live input
input.description: The natural-language input of the generate API; required for generateTaskPromptFromText records, rejected for validate records.

prompt.title: Live prompt input
prompt.description: The validate API's prompt: an inline text only — golden and fromStep are offline-only in the live family.

liveCaseFile.title: Live case corpus file
liveCaseFile.description: A file under live/ of the corpus root; its records land in the dedicated liveCases list, never in the offline cases list.

sharedResponsesFile.title: Shared LLM response payloads
sharedResponsesFile.description: Flat map of snake_case payload names to literal JSON string payloads; every reusable payload appears exactly once.

sharedSchemasFile.title: Shared JSON Schema variants
sharedSchemasFile.description: Flat map of schema names to JSON Schema objects referenced through the schemas/ prefix.
